Course highlights

Built to deliver legitimate career outcomes

  • Complete 3-Year Degree Faster

    Credit transfer carries your completed semesters across, so you resume rather than restart.

  • Official Certificates Provided

    Degree, consolidated marksheet and provisional certificate, issued by the university itself.

  • Valid for Government Jobs

    Accepted for UPSC, PSC, SSC and state services, on the same footing as a regular degree.

  • Career Growth & Promotions

    The qualification most promotion and salary bands are gated on, completed alongside the job.

  • Higher Studies (India & Abroad)

    Accepted for master’s and doctoral admission at home and overseas.

  • Migration & Attestation Support

    Migration certificates and attestation handled for you, whenever an employer asks.
